description: This file manages GitHub Copilot tokens, including fetching, caching, parsing responses, and deriving API URLs based on tokens.

classes.name: CachedCopilotToken
classes.description: Type representing a cached GitHub Copilot token with its expiry and update timestamps.

methods.name: resolveCopilotTokenCachePath
methods.description: Constructs the cache file path for the Copilot token based on environment variables.

methods.name: isTokenUsable
methods.description: Checks if a cached token is still valid based on its expiry time.

methods.name: parseCopilotTokenResponse
methods.description: Parses the response from the Copilot token endpoint to extract token and expiry information.

methods.name: deriveCopilotApiBaseUrlFromToken
methods.description: Derives the API base URL from the token, parsing proxy information if available.

methods.name: resolveCopilotApiToken
methods.description: Main function to retrieve a valid Copilot API token, either from cache or by fetching anew.
